name: text-scramble
title: Text Scramble Reveal
description: Monospace text that resolves out of noise glyphs. The real text is always in the DOM.

props.description: Animates its text. Extends every span prop except children.

props.name: text
props.description: The final text. Always in the DOM.

props.name: trigger
props.description: When it runs. visible waits for half the text on screen. manual runs when replayKey changes.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds until the last glyph resolves.

props.name: once
props.description: With visible, stop observing after the first reveal.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render, so headings keep their semantics.

props.name: variant
props.description: Type treatment. All three are monospace.

props.name: tone
props.description: Resolved text color. Noise glyphs use clay, or foreground for accent.

variants.name: variant
variants.description: label 12 px uppercase, heading 24 px medium, body 14 px.

accessibility: The final text is the element's real content. The animated copy is aria-hidden.
Both copies share one grid cell, so nothing shifts.
Reduced motion shows the final text immediately.
Use as to keep real heading levels.

animation.properties: Text of one span per glyph
animation.timing: One rAF loop. Noise reshuffles every 45 ms. 70 percent stagger, 30 percent jitter.
animation.trigger: Mount, half visible, pointer enter, focus or replayKey
